source.original_text:
Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel sigma algebra, including dimension zero. Let V:E->R, alpha,beta>=0 and eta in R. Assume alpha>0, alpha<=beta, V is C2, alpha||v||^2<=D2V(x)[v,v]<=beta||v||^2 for every x,v in E, eta>0 and beta*eta<=1.
For y,r in E put c=y-eta grad V(r), h_r(x)=grad V(x)-grad V(r), R(x,p)=(x,-p),
Phi_(y,r,u)(x,p)=(c+cos(u)(x-c)+sqrt(eta)sin(u)p, -sin(u)/sqrt(eta)(x-c)+cos(u)p),
S_r(x,p)=(x,p-(2<p,h_r(x)>/||h_r(x)||^2)h_r(x)). Real division by zero is zero, so a zero normal gives the identity bounce. Let ell=volume_E tensor volume_E, with canonical Hilbert-space Lebesgue measure.
For every integer n>=0 and horizon T>=0, let Delta_n(T) consist of real tuples 0<t_0<...<t_(n-1)<T. Equivalently, prepending 0 produces a strictly increasing tuple and every entry is less than T. Let Prefix_n(T) be this subtype and m_n,T the comap of Lebesgue measure on R^n under its inclusion. This is unnormalized simplex volume. For n=0 the tuple is empty and its zero-dimensional volume is one; for T=0 and n>0 the subtype is empty.
Write q_0=0 and q_(j+1)=t_j. Starting at z_0=z, define z_(j+1)=S_r(Phi_(y,r,t_j-q_j)(z_j)) for 0<=j<n. Define records K_j=(q_j,z_j), each embedded in the live branch of (R_nonnegative x (E x E)) plus a cemetery symbol. For a general history of n+1 such records, the path reconstruction Psi at s in [0,T] starts from z and visits records in increasing index order: a live record (a,w) replaces the accumulator by Phi_(y,r,s-a)(w) exactly when a<=s; future records and cemetery records leave it unchanged. Here s-a is nonnegative subtraction. Define Gamma_(y,r,z,t)=Psi(K), the actual finite prescribed path; thus its value at an event is the post-bounce value. Let A_(y,r)(z,t)=Gamma_(y,r,z,t)(T).
Define R(x,p)=(x,-p) and lambda_r(x,p)=sqrt(eta) max(0,<p,grad V(x)-grad V(r)>). For every finite n>=0 and T>=0 there exists rho:Prefix(n,T)->Prefix(n,T), with (rho(t))_i=T-t_(n-1-i). This witness is produced, not assumed. For every y,r,z and t in Prefix(n,T), let A=Gamma(y,r,z,n,T,t)(T) be the actual terminal state. Define gamma(s)=Gamma(y,r,z,n,T,t)(min(max(s,0),T)) and barGamma(s)=Gamma(y,r,R(A),n,T,rho(t))(min(max(s,0),T)). Here Gamma is precisely the prescribed finite-recursion path defined above, including its right-continuous event convention.
For every real s with 0<=s<=T and s different from every internal reversed event time (rho(t))_i, barGamma(s)=R(gamma(T-s)). Both real functions s->lambda_r(barGamma(s)) and s->lambda_r(R(gamma(s))) are interval integrable against real Lebesgue measure on [0,T]. Their integrals agree: integral_0^T lambda_r(barGamma(s)) ds = integral_0^T lambda_r(R(gamma(s))) ds.
The state identity includes both endpoints 0,T; only the finite internal event set is excluded. It asserts no pointwise identity at genuine jumps or outside the closed horizon. The functions are defined on all real times by clamping solely to express interval integrability and integration. The conclusion includes n=0, T=0, rank-zero spaces, zero normals and zero rates; when T=0 and n>0 the strict event subtype is empty. The exact unnormalized simplex measure m is retained in the literal interface but unused in this deterministic path and scalar integral result.
The only analytic premises are the original six assumptions. The reversed intermediate states, actual arc formula, flow group and momentum-conjugacy laws, and integrability of the actual reversed path rate are discharged using proved actual producers. This is the off-event trajectory and survival-substitution component of Appendix A.1. Weighted density matching, invariant probability, restart/Markovness, hypocoercivity, implementation error, actual expected costs, main results and PBPS/SPHMC composition remain separate.

{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
    let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
    let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let Rec := (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit
    let Hist : ℕ → Type _ := fun n => Fin (n + 1) → Rec
    let Δ : (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Set (Fin n → ℝ) := fun n T =>
      {t | StrictMono (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) t) ∧ ∀ i, t i < (T : ℝ)}
    let Prefix : (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Type := fun n T => {t : Fin n → ℝ // t ∈ Δ n T}
    let m : (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Measure (Prefix n T) := fun n T =>
      Measure.comap (fun t : Prefix n T => t.val) (volume : Measure (Fin n → ℝ))
    let zAt : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
        Prefix n T → Fin (n + 1) → (E × E) := fun y xRef z₀ n T t =>
      Fin.induction z₀ (fun i z =>
        S xRef (Φ y xRef (t.val i - (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i.castSucc) z))
    let K : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
        Prefix n T → Hist n := fun y xRef z₀ n T t j =>
      Sum.inl (Real.toNNReal ((Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) j), zAt y xRef z₀ n T t j)
    let Path : ℝ≥0 → Type _ := fun T => {s : ℝ≥0 // s ≤ T} → E × E
    let Ψ : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Hist n → Path T :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n T h s =>
        Fin.foldl (n + 1) (fun z j => (h j).elim
          (fun a => if a.1 ≤ s.val then Φ y xRef ((s.val - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2 else z)
          (fun _ => z)) z₀
    let Γ : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Prefix n T → Path T :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n T t => Ψ y xRef z₀ n T (K y xRef z₀ n T t)
    let R : E × E → E × E := fun z => (z.1, -z.2)
    let rate : E → E × E → ℝ := fun r z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V r))
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ T : ℝ≥0, ∃ rho : Prefix n T → Prefix n T,
      (∀ t : Prefix n T, ∀ i : Fin n, (rho t).val i = (T : ℝ) - t.val i.rev) ∧
      ∀ y r : E, ∀ z : E × E, ∀ t : Prefix n T,
        let A : E × E := Γ y r z n T t ⟨T, le_rfl⟩
        let gamma : ℝ → E × E := fun s =>
          Γ y r z n T t ⟨min (Real.toNNReal s) T, min_le_right _ _⟩
        let barGamma : ℝ → E × E := fun s =>
          Γ y r (R A) n T (rho t) ⟨min (Real.toNNReal s) T, min_le_right _ _⟩
        (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ (T : ℝ) →
          (∀ i : Fin n, s ≠ (rho t).val i) →
          barGamma s = R (gamma ((T : ℝ) - s))) ∧
        IntervalIntegrable (fun s => rate r (barGamma s)) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
        IntervalIntegrable (fun s => rate r (R (gamma s))) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
        (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(T : ℝ), rate r (barGamma s)) =
          ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(T : ℝ), rate r (R (gamma s))
decoder_context: The carrier is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with Borel measurable structure; gradient and fderiv are the real Hilbert gradient and Frechet derivative.
Fin n indexes coordinates from zero; Fin.rev sends i to n-1-i. Fin.cons prepends, Fin.induction performs finite recursion, and Fin.foldl visits indices in increasing order.
Real division by zero is zero. Real.toNNReal is the nonnegative part. Subtraction in nonnegative reals is truncated at zero. Sum.inl is a live record; Unit is a cemetery branch.

The path domain is a nonnegative closed-interval subtype. Its real extension uses clamping. IntervalIntegrable and the integral use real Lebesgue measure. Measure.comap is the unnormalized subtype measure; unused let definitions are not hypotheses.

/-! Actual finite prescribed PBPS path reversal away from internal jumps and
survival-integral substitution. Faithful mathematical restatement of the
Appendix A.1 reversal component in arXiv:2609.06905v1. This module does not
establish the weighted path law or stationary invariance. -/
namespace AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ActualPrescribedPathReversal
open MeasureTheory Set InnerProductSpace
open scoped ContDiff NNReal ENNReal Classical Interval
noncomputable section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 2400000

private theorem active_arc (n : ℕ) (a : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (ha : a 0 = 0)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    ∃ j, a j ≤ s ∧ ∀ k, j < k → s < a k := by
  let q : Finset (Fin (n+1)) := Finset.univ.filter (fun j => a j ≤ s)
  have hq : q.Nonempty := ⟨0, by simp [q, ha, hs]⟩
  refine ⟨q.max' hq, (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.max'_mem q hq)).2, ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  by_contra h
  have hm : k ∈ q := by simp [q, le_of_not_gt h]
  exact (not_le_of_gt hk) (Finset.le_max' q k hm)

private theorem path_reversal {X : Type*} (n : ℕ) (T : ℝ)
    (a b : Fin (n+2) → ℝ) (ha : Monotone a)
    (hb0 : b 0 = 0) (hbT : b (Fin.last (n+1)) = T)
    (hbl : ∀ j : Fin (n+1), b j.castSucc = T - a j.rev.succ)
    (hbr : ∀ j : Fin (n+1), b j.succ = T - a j.rev.castSucc)
    (Φ : ℝ → X → X) (R : X → X) (hR : Function.Involutive R)
    (hgroup : ∀ u v x, Φ (u+v) x = Φ u (Φ v x))
    (hrev : ∀ u x, R (Φ u (R x)) = Φ (-u) x)
    (post barPost : Fin (n+1) → X) (f g : ℝ → X)
    (hstate : ∀ j, barPost j =
      R (Φ (a j.rev.succ - a j.rev.castSucc) (post j.rev)))
    (hf : ∀ s, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ T → ∀ j : Fin (n+1),
      a j.castSucc ≤ s → (∀ k, j < k → s < a k.castSucc) →
      f s = Φ (s-a j.castSucc) (post j))
    (hg : ∀ s, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ T → ∀ j : Fin (n+1),
      b j.castSucc ≤ s → (∀ k, j < k → s < b k.castSucc) →
      g s = Φ (s-b j.castSucc) (barPost j)) :
    ∀ s, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ T → (∀ i : Fin n, s ≠ b i.succ.castSucc) →
      g s = R (f (T-s)) := by
  intro s hs0 hsT hne
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hjafter⟩ := active_arc n (fun j => b j.castSucc) (by simpa using hb0) s hs0
  have hnext : s ≤ b j.succ := by
    induction j using Fin.lastCases with
    | last => simpa only [Fin.succ_last, hbT] using hsT
    | cast i =>
      simpa only [Fin.succ_castSucc] using (hjafter i.succ Fin.castSucc_lt_succ).le
  have hstart : a j.rev.castSucc ≤ T-s := by
    rw [hbr] at hnext
    linarith

private def actual_prescribed_path_reversal_statement
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) : Prop := by
  classical
  exact
    let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
    let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
    let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let Rec := (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit
    let Hist : ℕ → Type _ := fun n => Fin (n + 1) → Rec
    let Δ : (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Set (Fin n → ℝ) := fun n T =>
      {t | StrictMono (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) t) ∧ ∀ i, t i < (T : ℝ)}
    let Prefix : (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Type := fun n T => {t : Fin n → ℝ // t ∈ Δ n T}
    let m : (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Measure (Prefix n T) := fun n T =>
      Measure.comap (fun t : Prefix n T => t.val) (volume : Measure (Fin n → ℝ))
    let zAt : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
        Prefix n T → Fin (n + 1) → (E × E) := fun y xRef z₀ n T t =>
      Fin.induction z₀ (fun i z =>
        S xRef (Φ y xRef (t.val i - (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i.castSucc) z))
    let K : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →

      Sum.inl (Real.toNNReal ((Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) j), zAt y xRef z₀ n T t j)
    let Path : ℝ≥0 → Type _ := fun T => {s : ℝ≥0 // s ≤ T} → E × E
    let Ψ : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Hist n → Path T :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n T h s =>
        Fin.foldl (n + 1) (fun z j => (h j).elim
          (fun a => if a.1 ≤ s.val then Φ y xRef ((s.val - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2 else z)

    let Γ : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Prefix n T → Path T :=

      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V r))

        let barGamma : ℝ → E × E := fun s =>
          Γ y r (R A) n T (rho t) ⟨min (Real.toNNReal s) T, min_le_right _ _⟩

    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ActualPhaseReversalVolume.actual_phase_reversal_volume_laws
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη

      (∀ i : Fin n, s ≠ (rho t).val i) → barGamma s = R (gamma ((T : ℝ)-s)) := by

      (by simp [barGrid]) (by simp [barGrid]) hbl hbr (Φ y r) R hR
      (hgroup y r) (hrev y r) post barPost gamma barGamma hpair
      (fun s hs0 hsT j hj hn => by
        simpa only [gamma, grid, post, Fin.snoc_castSucc] using
          harc z t s hs0 hsT j (by simpa only [grid, Fin.snoc_castSucc] using hj)
            (by simpa only [grid, Fin.snoc_castSucc] using hn))
      (fun s hs0 hsT j hj hn => by
        simpa only [barGamma, barGrid, barPost, Fin.snoc_castSucc] using
          harc (R A) (rho t) s hs0 hsT j (by simpa only [barGrid, Fin.snoc_castSucc] using hj)
            (by simpa only [barGrid, Fin.snoc_castSucc] using hn))
    intro s hs0 hsT hn

    (AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ActualPrescribedPathDensity.actual_prescribed_path_density_rewrite
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη y r (R A) n T (rho t)).1

    (fun s => rate r (R (gamma s))) (fun s => rate r (barGamma s))
    (Set.range (rho t).val) (Set.finite_range _) (by
      intro s hs hn
      exact congrArg (rate r) (hoff s hs.1 hs.2 (fun i he => hn ⟨i, he.symm⟩))) hi
  exact ⟨hoff, hi, hs⟩

Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel sigma algebra, including dimension zero. Let V:E->R, alpha,beta>=0 and eta in R. Assume alpha>0, alpha<=beta, V is C2, alpha||v||^2<=D2V(x)[v,v]<=beta||v||^2 for every x,v in E, eta>0 and beta*eta<=1.
For y,r in E put c=y-eta grad V(r), h_r(x)=grad V(x)-grad V(r), R(x,p)=(x,-p),
Phi_(y,r,u)(x,p)=(c+cos(u)(x-c)+sqrt(eta)sin(u)p, -sin(u)/sqrt(eta)(x-c)+cos(u)p),
S_r(x,p)=(x,p-(2<p,h_r(x)>/||h_r(x)||^2)h_r(x)). Real division by zero is zero, so a zero normal gives the identity bounce. Let ell=volume_E tensor volume_E, with canonical Hilbert-space Lebesgue measure.
For every integer n>=0 and horizon T>=0, let Delta_n(T) consist of real tuples 0<t_0<...<t_(n-1)<T. Equivalently, prepending 0 produces a strictly increasing tuple and every entry is less than T. Let Prefix_n(T) be this subtype and m_n,T the comap of Lebesgue measure on R^n under its inclusion. This is unnormalized simplex volume. For n=0 the tuple is empty and its zero-dimensional volume is one; for T=0 and n>0 the subtype is empty.
Write q_0=0 and q_(j+1)=t_j. Starting at z_0=z, define z_(j+1)=S_r(Phi_(y,r,t_j-q_j)(z_j)) for 0<=j<n. Define records K_j=(q_j,z_j), each embedded in the live branch of (R_nonnegative x (E x E)) plus a cemetery symbol. For a general history of n+1 such records, the path reconstruction Psi at s in [0,T] starts from z and visits records in increasing index order: a live record (a,w) replaces the accumulator by Phi_(y,r,s-a)(w) exactly when a<=s; future records and cemetery records leave it unchanged. Here s-a is nonnegative subtraction. Define Gamma_(y,r,z,t)=Psi(K), the actual finite prescribed path; thus its value at an event is the post-bounce value. Let A_(y,r)(z,t)=Gamma_(y,r,z,t)(T).
Define R(x,p)=(x,-p) and lambda_r(x,p)=sqrt(eta) max(0,<p,grad V(x)-grad V(r)>). For every finite n>=0 and T>=0 there exists rho:Prefix(n,T)->Prefix(n,T), with (rho(t))_i=T-t_(n-1-i). This witness is produced, not assumed. For every y,r,z and t in Prefix(n,T), let A=Gamma(y,r,z,n,T,t)(T) be the actual terminal state. Define gamma(s)=Gamma(y,r,z,n,T,t)(min(max(s,0),T)) and barGamma(s)=Gamma(y,r,R(A),n,T,rho(t))(min(max(s,0),T)). Here Gamma is precisely the prescribed finite-recursion path defined above, including its right-continuous event convention.
For every real s with 0<=s<=T and s different from every internal reversed event time (rho(t))_i, barGamma(s)=R(gamma(T-s)). Both real functions s->lambda_r(barGamma(s)) and s->lambda_r(R(gamma(s))) are interval integrable against real Lebesgue measure on [0,T]. Their integrals agree: integral_0^T lambda_r(barGamma(s)) ds = integral_0^T lambda_r(R(gamma(s))) ds.
The state identity includes both endpoints 0,T; only the finite internal event set is excluded. It asserts no pointwise identity at genuine jumps or outside the closed horizon. The functions are defined on all real times by clamping solely to express interval integrability and integration. The conclusion includes n=0, T=0, rank-zero spaces, zero normals and zero rates; when T=0 and n>0 the strict event subtype is empty. The exact unnormalized simplex measure m is retained in the literal interface but unused in this deterministic path and scalar integral result.
The only analytic premises are the original six assumptions. The reversed intermediate states, actual arc formula, flow group and momentum-conjugacy laws, and integrability of the actual reversed path rate are discharged using proved actual producers. This is the off-event trajectory and survival-substitution component of Appendix A.1. Weighted density matching, invariant probability, restart/Markovness, hypocoercivity, implementation error, actual expected costs, main results and PBPS/SPHMC composition remain separate.

steps.title: Remove the finite exceptional set and reflect time

Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel sigma algebra, including dimension zero. Let V:E->R, alpha,beta>=0 and eta in R. Assume alpha>0, alpha<=beta, V is C2, alpha||v||^2<=D2V(x)[v,v]<=beta||v||^2 for every x,v in E, eta>0 and beta*eta<=1.
For y,r in E put c=y-eta grad V(r), h_r(x)=grad V(x)-grad V(r), R(x,p)=(x,-p),
Phi_(y,r,u)(x,p)=(c+cos(u)(x-c)+sqrt(eta)sin(u)p, -sin(u)/sqrt(eta)(x-c)+cos(u)p),
S_r(x,p)=(x,p-(2<p,h_r(x)>/||h_r(x)||^2)h_r(x)). Real division by zero is zero, so a zero normal gives the identity bounce. Let ell=volume_E tensor volume_E, with canonical Hilbert-space Lebesgue measure.

Let Prefix_n(T) be this subtype and m_n,T the comap of Lebesgue measure on R^n under its inclusion. This is unnormalized simplex volume. For n=0 the tuple is empty and its zero-dimensional volume is one; for T=0 and n>0 the subtype is empty.
